input.brief_text: Necesitamos dos archivos para Acme: PDF y JSON. Ambos deben contener la cadena exacta "Ready to ship". Plazo: 15 de noviembre. Presupuesto: 500 EUR. Se supone que los datos de origen ya se han proporcionado. Escribe este análisis en inglés.
input.deliverable_text: Solo se ha entregado el PDF para Acme con la cadena "Ready to ship". No se ha entregado el JSON. Se han respetado el plazo y el presupuesto.

document.summary: The work does not meet expectations because the required JSON file is missing. The first priority is to deliver the JSON file for Acme containing the exact string "Ready to ship".

sections.title: Verdict
sections.content: The work does not meet expectations. Scope coverage is not satisfied: the brief requires both PDF and JSON files for Acme, but the delivery states that only the PDF was delivered and the JSON was not delivered. Requirement fit is not satisfied: both files must contain the exact string "Ready to ship"; the delivery confirms this string in the PDF, but the required JSON is absent, and it states that the deadline and budget were respected. Completeness is not satisfied: of the two required deliverables, PDF and JSON, only the PDF is present according to the delivery text. Clarity is satisfied: the delivery plainly identifies the PDF as delivered, confirms its required string, explicitly says the JSON was not delivered, and states that the deadline and budget were respected. The verdict is judged on these four general review criteria, not item by item on the acceptance criteria listed below.
